Subject: Intro + Dedicated/Private demo — regional reviewers (EU DPO / APAC Security)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier this week. Acuity is evaluating a Dedicated/Private deployment for some PII-handling workflows and our legal/security teams want to do the regional review before we move to a deeper technical POC.

We have two sets of reviewers who need to be present: our EU Data Protection Officer (Sophie Dubois) for the EEA data flow questions, and our APAC security lead (Kenji Saito) for localization and network controls. Can Redwood do a split session if needed (short overview + EU DPO review, then APAC deep dive), or are you proposing a single longer session?

High-level ask: a demo that covers architecture (VPC/private control plane), key controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs), and then 30–45 minutes for region-specific Q&A.

Availability: Sophie is only available in CEST mornings next week (12–16 Jun) and Kenji can do evenings JST in the same window. Martin here is flexible.

Would appreciate proposed slots (include UTC and a note on DST offsets) and any pre-read or SOC docs you can share.

Thanks,
Martin
Martin Bailey
Head of IT Architecture
Acuity Health Systems

Hi Martin — thanks, and happy to coordinate.

Short answer: yes, we usually run two shorter, focused sessions when reviewers are spread across timezones; that keeps the technical deep-dive tailored and avoids very late/early hours for participants.

Notes on timezone/DST: in mid-June 2026 the common offsets are: PDT = UTC-7, CEST = UTC+2 (EU in DST), JST = UTC+9 (no DST). To avoid math mistakes I’ll propose UTC times and list local equivalents.

Proposed plan (two sessions):

1) EU + US cross-review — high-level demo + EU DPO deep-dive (60 min)
   - Option A: 2026-06-15 09:00 UTC (02:00 PDT / 11:00 CEST) — early for US West; NOT ideal
   - Option B (preferred): 2026-06-15 13:00 UTC (06:00 PDT / 15:00 CEST) — catches EU afternoon and early US east; may be early for West Coast

2) APAC technical deep-dive — focused on network/KMS/localization (45–60 min)
   - Option C: 2026-06-16 03:00 UTC (20:00 PDT 16 Jun / 05:00 CEST 16 Jun / 12:00 JST 16 Jun) — OK for Japan lunch, late for US
   - Option D (preferred for Kenji): 2026-06-16 09:00 UTC (02:00 PDT / 11:00 CEST / 18:00 JST) — evening JST, workable for Kenji, early for US but tolerable for small group

If these split sessions look acceptable we’ll send two invites and include the following Redwood attendees: Marcus Lin (AE, technical lead on the demo), Soojin Lee (APAC security reviews), and myself. I’ll also attach a short agenda and our SOC2 summary in the follow-up.

Can you confirm Sophie and Kenji’s preferred options (B + D would be our recommended pair)? If Sophie needs an earlier EU time we can swap to Option A for the EU slot and keep the APAC slot as Option D.

Thanks — I’ll hold the provisional slots on our calendar until I hear back.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
